description: This file contains unit tests for the UrlLang parser class within the Goteo project, specifically testing URL parsing, domain handling, and redirection logic.

classes.name: UrlLangTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing URL parsing and host management functionality of the UrlLang parser class.

methods.name: getParser
methods.description: Helper method to instantiate a UrlLang parser with a given URL and host.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Verifies that the UrlLang parser instance can be created properly.

methods.name: testSkipSessionManagement
methods.description: Tests whether the parser correctly determines when to skip session management based on URL and configuration.

methods.name: testDomainLang
methods.description: Checks that the parser correctly interprets domain and language settings, including configuration overrides.

methods.name: testRedirectSkip
methods.description: Verifies the parser's behavior for redirect URLs where session management might be skipped.

methods.name: testFixedRedirection
methods.description: Tests URL handling for fixed redirection paths to ensure correct hostnames.

methods.name: testSubdomains
methods.description: Ensures subdomain parsing and language-related subdomain adjustments work correctly.
